candidateCountCaveat: Includes duplicate views, logos, posters, collages and food-only images; not a count of unique access photographs.

visualReviewGroups.result: Linked 27 actual project views. hbm-29 shows parking/curb transition; hbm-20 shows a raised indoor platform with steps. Other views cover entrance frontage, information desk, shelf aisles, glass room doors, seating and patio. Future-tense design prose is not current operations or bus-service evidence; no licensed reuse.

Linked 11 venue photos; excluded catering poster. Host/entry area, tables/booths/high stools, colorful lighting, patio/fireplace and snow in exterior view. Publisher entrance label does not establish an exterior door or measurements.

Scheben official wide frontage view linked. Hebron/Walton frontage images alone were superseded by deeper galleries. Commons Scheben rear facade (Mhuy222, December 31 2019, CC BY-SA 4.0) inspected and not republished: does not show useful arrival/entry continuity. Union Kentucky category and photographer page followed; no better documented licensed route photograph selected.

Three Brown + Kubican ground-level views selected: front approach with bollards, service desk, exterior seating. Roof view excluded; credited Frank Doring, project 2024, capture unknown. Omni candidates include logos, non-Walton project cards and people-focused views; no extra guide. No reuse licence found.

Both original venue photographs linked. Long table/bar stools and low lounge table with closely surrounding chairs, sofa, rugs and piano. No entrance or toilet proof; furniture movement and route clearance remain questions.

Current site carousel is food-only. Legacy Squarespace gallery contains screenshots, old promotions, people-focused exterior and limited bar image, so no guide selected. Everything Cincy images led to the original June 25 2021 Visit Cincy/meetNKY account; four original images inspected and linked: raised corner doorway with railings, room seating, window-counter passage, covered patio. No current alternative-entrance or winter-operation inference. Tourism image URLs from the Kentucky listing returned 403 and were not inspected.

59 candidate files screened, including logos, collages, food and people-focused social views. Selected only the unoccupied coworking room photo (fort-cowork-2) for the guide: freestanding tables/chairs, banquette, high counter/stools, drinks counter and doors. No measured clearance or sound-level inference. Rules graphic was visually read but not imported as a source_checked factual note: quiet-hours/playhouse scope is not whole-café quiet, and live-music calendar differs. Official Matterport embed identified but not interactively inspected because browser host unavailable.
Storywalk graphic/photo composite and logo inspected; no documentary route image or length/gradient claim selected.

pdfReviews.visualReview: Both pages rendered and visually inspected. Approved October 2023, currently linked; no-charge branch tables and first-come/reservation limitations separately fetched. No photo guide for this text policy.

All nine PDF pages rendered and visually inspected; many are two-page spreads. Page 7 Walton entrance and labeled restroom/table, courtyard, EV and BIL images inspected, including five embedded images at native resolution. Restroom shows padded table, two toilets and grab rails; no dimensions, load limit, adjustment/hoist, transfer-help or current-condition inference. Source report remains external. Metadata January 29 2026; fiscal year 2024–25; exact captures unknown.
